author: EDJM9
body:
Clijmart wanted to keep the Solvite feel, but I wanted to make it CTW. Note: BEDROCK WALL AROUND MAP WILL NOT BE THERE. Heres a list of stuff done:

-Some supplies
-Removed Core
-Removed Emerald Monument
-Removed Iron Reserve Behind Spawn
-Removed Some Diamonds
+2 Wool Rooms
+Iron Reserve where old core used to be
+Lane To Wool Room

http://imgur.com/a/m6aY7

replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
I like it, just a few issues I can see:
- Wool rooms only enter from top could be really hard, to get in, and to get out.
- Players can jump around the lane bedrock wall, which could make it quite easy to rush.
- Short wool lane, hard to defend.

Love it tho ;)
